answer: Require every agent to post a bond that is locked for a fixed period, then randomly audit a small sample of its claimed actions against signed receipts from counterparties. If an audit finds fabricated activity, slash the bond and exclude the agent; otherwise release it after the lockup. One identity earns only one chance at a reward, so splitting into sybils does not multiply trusted work. The attacker must fund and maintain each identity’s bond, tie up capital, and risk losing it; names like shale, lotus, and cedar add no trust by themselves.
